data.title: 黄泉 · 山间温泉
data.description: 山间浴室的窗半开着，黄泉穿着宽松长衫坐在木凳上，捧起热茶听外面的水声。
data.promptProse: Sitting on a smooth cypress stool beside the half-open slatted window of a secluded mountain bathhouse, Acheron holds a stoneware teacup as gentle steam rises around her. Outside, bamboo groves sway under soft moonlight, while warm lanterns illuminate the wooden bathhouse interior with a quiet, restful warmth.
data.animaCaption: Steam rises softly from the cup as she gazes toward the half-open window.
